Enum Class Arg

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Arg>
org.apache.rat.commandline.Arg
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Arg>, Constable
public enum Arg extends Enum<Arg>
An enumeration of options that are recommended across all UIs. A UI may not implement some options if they are unsupportable within the UI. Each Arg contains:
  • An OptionGroup that contains the individual options that all resolve to the same option. This allows us to deprecate options as we move forward in development.
  • A BiConsumer<ArgumentContext, Option> that defines the process to configure the option in the ArgumentContext.configuration.
